series.title: Dino Pals
series.tagline: Learn something new with your dinosaur friends every day!

rexy.name: Rexy
rexy.personality: Brave, clumsy and big-hearted. Tries to roar fiercely but often trips over his own tail. Loves learning new things.

trixie.name: Trixie
trixie.personality: Clever, kind and calm. The problem solver who thinks before acting and always includes everyone.

sam.name: Stego Sam
sam.personality: Sleepy, funny and loves snacks. Makes silly jokes and takes naps at the worst moments.

pip.name: Pip
pip.personality: Tiny, fast-talking and endlessly curious. Asks lots of questions and sees everything from the sky.

dina.name: Dr. Dina
dina.personality: Cheerful scientist with a magic fossil brush. Explains one real dinosaur fact per episode in a simple, friendly way.

style: Write like a hit preschool show: warm, funny, musical and full of energy. Very short lines (mostly under 12 words) and simple words a 4-year-old knows.
Use sound words and rhythm ('Stomp, stomp, stomp!', 'Whoosh!', 'Splash!') and phrases kids can repeat. Repeat the key fact word several times.

Make it INTERACTIVE: 3 to 6 times, a character asks the viewer to do or answer something simple ('Can you roar like Rexy?', 'Let us count the eggs: 1, 2, 3!', 'Which one is the leaf?'). On exactly those lines set pause to 3 (seconds of waiting). The NEXT line must warmly react to the viewer ('Great roaring!', 'You are so smart!').
Tell a tiny story: a small, friendly problem, the friends solve it with teamwork and kindness, and one funny moment (Sam napping at the wrong time, Pip asking 'why?', Rexy tripping over his tail).
Give every line an emotion: happy, excited, surprised or silly. Use 'surprised' and 'excited' for discoveries and big moments, 'silly' for jokes.

When a line names something that can be shown, set show to one picture (leaf, egg, bone, footprint, fish, tooth, star, heart, rock, feather, flower, sun). Use it on at most 9 lines in the whole episode.

Teach exactly ONE real, scientifically accurate dinosaur fact, stated simply by Dr. Dina in the 'fact' segment, then repeated in a playful way by a friend. If unsure of a fact, pick a different fact you are certain about.
The 'song' segment is a 6 to 10 line bouncy rhyming chant about the fact. Lines are short, rhyme in pairs, and the chorus lines repeat. Several characters take turns.
Keep every character true to their personality. Use each catchphrase at most once per episode.
Warm, gentle and positive. Nothing scary or violent. Predators are never cruel. Problems are solved with teamwork, kindness and curiosity.
End every episode with the daily sign-off.
